chapter_seo_title: Desolate Era Ch. 241: Nine Lotos is Forcibly Taken from Ji Ning by the Dongyan Clan
chapter_meta_description: The Dongyan clan arrives in force to take Nine Lotos away. Ji Ning withstands a divine sense assault and hears the crushing words: "You are not worthy."
og_title: Desolate Era Ch. 241: The Dongyan Clan Arrives
og_description: Ji Ning shares a precious moment with Nine Lotos as she tells him the story of Immortal Dongyou, but their peace is shattered by the arrival of a Dongyan clan war fleet.
twitter_title: Ji Ning vs. the Dongyan Clan
twitter_description: A romantic moment on Serpentwing Lake is broken as a Loose Immortal arrives to take Nine Lotos away, telling Ji Ning he is unworthy.

lore_anchors.definition: A legendary Immortal wine created by Immortal Dongyou, symbolizing steadfast love and the defiance of heaven for the sake of a Dao-companion.
A Loose Immortal of the Dongyan clan, tasked with bringing Nine Lotos back. He commands nine Primal Daoist disciples and the Xuanming Guards.
The ancient, reclusive true leader of the Dongyan clan, believed to be a Celestial Immortal. His word is absolute law within the clan.
A telepathic attack where a cultivator uses their spiritual sense to directly pressure or damage an opponent's soul.
The elite Wanxiang Adept guard force of the Dongyan clan, clad in standard Dao-soldier armor.
A cultivator who failed to become a Celestial Immortal in a past life but chose to reincarnate for a second chance, retaining some of their former soul's power.
